title: lactuca boissieri
intro: Lactuca boissieri, commonly known as the Boissier's lettuce or wild lettuce, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Lactuca boissieri include sedation, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of Lactuca boissieri include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
